root_cause.mechanism: The commit replaced `pkgutil.get_loader` with `importlib.util.find_spec`. When running a script directly, `__name__` is `"__main__"`. If `sys.modules["__main__"].__spec__` is `None` (which is common when running scripts directly), `importlib.util.find_spec("__main__")` raises `ValueError: __main__.__spec__ is None`. This caused `Flask(__name__)` to fail during initialization.

hypotheses.text: The recent change replaced `pkgutil.get_loader(root_mod_name)` with `importlib.util.find_spec(root_mod_name)`. When `root_mod_name` is `"__main__"`, `find_spec` raises `ValueError` if `sys.modules["__main__"].__spec__` is `None`. This happens when running a script directly. Previously `pkgutil.get_loader("__main__")` did not raise this error.
hypotheses.predicts: Running a script that calls `Flask(__name__)` will fail with `ValueError: __main__.__spec__ is None` when `__spec__` is not set on `__main__`.
